20261122-physics-e2-2.thinking.0: Kana uchirova xylophone, ndeupi musiyano wakarurama
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Kana uchirova xylophone, ndeupi musiyano wakarurama pakati peruzha rwekiyi pfupi nerwekiyi refu?
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Kiyi kana yapfupika, kuwanda kwekudengenyeka pachipiri (frequency) kunowedzera, saka ruzha runova rwakakwirira; kana yareba, frequency inoderera uye ruzha runova rwakadzika.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Chinhu chikapfupika uye chikatetepa, chinodengenyeka nokukurumidza muchipiri chimwe.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Kana frequency yakawanda, ruzha runova rwakakwirira.
